newsitem.title: USA: D&P upgrades WorldCom senior rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P upgrades WorldCom senior rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it upgraded WorldCom Inc's senior implied rating to Triple B Minus from Double B Plus.
WorldCom has registered a $3 billion shelf and has $4.8 billion in bank debt and MFS Communications Co Inc senior notes outstanding.

The upgrade recognizes WorldCom's strong position in the commercial, carrier and international long distance market segments, Duff & Phelps said. The company's merger with MFS gives it access to a large installed local network base.
